parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
A list of tests for different organic groups is given in Table 6.1.

Complete Table 6.1 to identify an organic functional group, in aliphatic compounds, that produces a positive result in each test.

Table 6.1

| test |  |  |  |  |  |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| sodium metal | $\text{Na}_2\text{CO}_3\text{(aq)}$ | 2,4-DNPH | $\text{I}_2\text{(aq)}$ + $\text{OH}^-\text{(aq)}$ | warm with Fehling's reagent | $\text{Br}_2\text{(aq)}$ |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem:
Lavandulol is an aliphatic organic compound and the major component of lavender oil. Fig. 6.1 shows a reaction scheme involving lavandulol, **A**.

{{figure:pdf_visual_01.png}}

Fig. 6.1

Table 6.2 shows the results obtained when the tests in Table 6.1 are carried out on the eight organic compounds, **A**-**H**, in the reaction scheme in Fig. 6.1.

Table 6.2

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Deduce the functional group present in compound **A** using both the molecular formulae of **A** and **B** and the reaction of **B** with Fehling's reagent.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
Name the type of reaction that occurs in each of the following conversions.

{{figure:pdf_visual_02.png}}

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Use the information in Table 6.2 and the molecular formulae to deduce structures for **G** and **H**. Draw your structures in Fig. 6.1.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text: Use the information in Table 6.2, the molecular formulae and your answer to (b)(iii) to deduce structures for **A**, **C**, **D**, **E** and **F**. Draw your structures in Fig. 6.1.
